title: Tenma Tsukasa — A Moment All Its Own〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
Five minutes before classes start. I made it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa, good morning.
It's not like you to cut it so close.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it's because I forgot to set my alarm. I ended up waking up thirty minutes late as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However!
I was able to make it in time by sprinting over at full speed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All thanks to the training I did with Mr. Kijima to play Heihachi properly! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm impressed.
You're still as agile as when you caught Chusuke.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. I could climb up the wall and come in through that window if it came down to it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure a hall monitor should be doing something like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-No, I was just giving an example!
A hall monitor would never do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, we're assembling in the gym!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's time for us to hear another one of the principal's extended speeches following a long holiday.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: To conclude, I hope that you'll all be mindful of your health.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This speech was shorter than normal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But this seems like a good length.
The longer his speech, the more likely it is that some students will start fooling around and have to be warned to stop.)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Next, I'd like to take this time to present a few commendations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hm? Commendations? That's rare...
Did one of the clubs achieve good results or something?)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Please come join me on stage after I call your name and class.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Class 3-C, Rui Kamishiro and Tsukasa Tenma. Class 2-A, Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: The school received a letter of thanks from the Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park naming the three of you. Please come to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The park sent a letter...?
Oh, I see. Now I understand!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is a nice surprise.
Let's start heading up, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “For assisting with the investigation into the thefts which took place at Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park, pursuing the perpetrator alongside the members of Mikazukigumi...”

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “...and contributing greatly towards the resolution of the matter, we would like to formally recognize your valor and courage. On behalf of the park staff, you have our deepest thanks.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We humbly accept.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. He's certainly excited.
That was probably audible from outside the gym.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
Thank you!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please be careful not to have your things stolen, everyone! Promise me that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Again, you're being way too loud...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, we should probably step down from the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to receive a commendation for what we did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Honestly, me neither.
That took me by complete surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, it is nice to be recognized in such a manner...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel more motivated than ever before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. As both the one who caught that thief and a hall monitor, I feel even more compelled to help keep Kamiyama High School safe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, now I see.
I'm glad that our school has such a good hall monitor in its employ.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I am good at my job, no?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Between my training with Mr. Kijima and all the time I spent chasing Chusuke, I doubt anyone at this school will be able to escape me...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Over here, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! You snuck in again?!
That's it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
Tsukasa's going to have his hands full for quite a while it seems.
